  [![MIT license](https://img.shields.io/github/license/Danissemo/ForeverFlip?color=blue)](https://github.com/ErorNya/ForeverFlip/blob/main/LICENSE)

### Scan the whole auction house, find lots worth flipping, check them live and buy, post and track profit, all from one tab.

  [User guide](https://github.com/ErorNya/ForeverFlip/blob/main/docs/user-guide.md) ·
  [How it works](https://github.com/ErorNya/ForeverFlip/blob/main/docs/how-it-works.md) ·
  [Changelog](https://github.com/ErorNya/ForeverFlip/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) ·
  [Download](https://github.com/Danissemo/ForeverFlip/releases/latest)

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **ForeverFlip never trades on its own.** Every purchase, bid, post and cancel starts with your click
> or key press. In the background it only reads the auction house, at the pace the server allows.

> [!CAUTION]
> Download ForeverFlip only from the [Releases](https://github.com/Danissemo/ForeverFlip/releases) page
> of this repository. GitHub shows the SHA-256 of every file on the release page; compare it with
> `certutil -hashfile ForeverFlip-<version>.zip SHA256` (Windows) or `sha256sum` (Linux, macOS).

## 💡 Why ForeverFlip

- **Free and on its own.** No subscription, no desktop app required, no other addon needed.
- **Tells you what a deal is worth before you buy.** Profit after the auction cut and deposits,
  how many sell a day (**Est./day**) and the chance it sells at your price (**Sure**), learned from
  the sales on your own realm.
- **Checks every deal live.** Nothing can be bought from an old scan: an exact search confirms the
  price first.
- **Gets better with every player.** Scans shared through [ForeverFlip Sync](https://github.com/ErorNya/ForeverFlip/blob/main/docs/community.md) fill
  in the prices of items you have not seen sell yet; the Share tab shows how many players share
  scans of your auction house.
- **Shows what really paid.** **Analytics → By strategy** books every sale against what it cost.

## 📸 Screenshots

  ![Deals → Resale: buy price, sell price, profit, sales a day and the chance to sell for each deal](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ErorNya/ForeverFlip/main/.github/assets/screenshots/deals.png)
  
**Deals.** What each lot costs, what it sells for, the profit after the cut, how many sell a day and how sure the sale is.

  

    
![Item tooltip with prices, demand, the best time to buy and what you hold](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ErorNya/ForeverFlip/main/.github/assets/screenshots/tooltip.png)

      **Tooltip.** Vendor and auction prices, sales a day, the best time to buy and what you paid.

    
![Professions → Crafting: materials, product, profit per recipe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ErorNya/ForeverFlip/main/.github/assets/screenshots/professions.png)

      **Professions.** Each recipe you know: materials against the product, and where to sell it.

  

  

    
![Selling → My items: best place to sell each item from the bags](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ErorNya/ForeverFlip/main/.github/assets/screenshots/selling.png)

      **Selling.** Auction or vendor for each item in the bags, with price, quantity and duration.

    
![Settings → General: minimum profit, money limits, market reset and posting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ErorNya/ForeverFlip/main/.github/assets/screenshots/settings.png)

      **Settings.** Profit thresholds and money limits, or one click: Careful, Balanced, Aggressive.

  

  

    
![ForeverFlip Sync window: game, sharing, updater and community prices](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ErorNya/ForeverFlip/main/.github/assets/screenshots/sync-helper.png)

      **ForeverFlip Sync** (optional). Community prices, shared scans and automatic updates.

  

## ✨ Feature highlights

**Finding deals**

- **Full scans:** every auction of the house, often more than 200 000, read in small portions so
  the game never freezes. One per 15 minutes, optionally automatic while the auction house is open, and scans
  of other addons are read too.
- **Fast sniper:** browse rounds read the lowest price of every item in seconds; hot items and your
  shopping list are re-read 100 at a time; every suspicious price is checked at once.
- **Vendor deals:** lots below what a vendor pays. Buy, sell to any merchant, keep the difference,
  with no market risk. The real price a merchant pays is learned from the buyback list, because
  WoW Forever's server pays less than the game's item data for some items.
- **Resale:** lots far below the next seller, for items that really sell at the resale price.
  - Sales are tracked auction by auction.
  - Profit counts the auction cut and the deposit risk.
- **Shopping list:** your items and your price; cheaper lots become deals.
- **Disenchant deals** for enchanters.
- **Bids** on auctions about to end.
- **Crafting:** what is worth crafting, priced from your recipes, auction and merchant prices.
- **Live check:** nothing can be bought until an exact search confirms the deal in the last 5 minutes.
- **Alerts:** a sound, a screen message and a green mark in the game's Buy tab.

**Selling**

- **Posting rules:** undercut by a step or a percent, minimum and maximum price, units to keep, hold
  below the minimum. Never below your break-even.
- **Post next bought / Post all:** all available units across bag stacks, one click per item, at the right price and the selected duration
  (24 hours by default, or **Auto**).
- **Cancel undercut:** cancels undercut auctions one by one, only when the repost still pays.
- **One-click chores:** take all auction mail, sell all vendor deals at a merchant.

**Accounting and analytics**

- **Books from auction mail:** the real sale amounts, the learned cut, and the sale rate of every item.
- **Analytics:**
  - profit per day, return and hit rate;
  - best and worst items;
  - gold and stock of all your characters;
  - market lists and the time-of-week price pattern.
- **History:** a 14-day price chart for any item (right-click), and tooltip prices with their age.
- **Shared scans:** pool full scans with every ForeverFlip user of your realm over a hidden channel,
  with your guild, group or friends, or with the whole community through GitHub ([ForeverFlip Sync](https://github.com/ErorNya/ForeverFlip/blob/main/docs/community.md)); full scans are archived unchanged
  in [ForeverFlip-Data](https://github.com/Danissemo/ForeverFlip-Data).
- **Export:** the journal as CSV.
- **Safety:** a spending limit per visit, cheap lots left for others, and tooltip advice: vendor,
  disenchant or auction house.
- **Comfort:** key bindings (including "buy the next best deal"), Careful / Balanced / Aggressive
  presets, `ForeverFlipAPI` for other addons, English and Ukrainian.

## 📦 Installation

1. Download `ForeverFlip-<version>.zip` from the [latest release](https://github.com/Danissemo/ForeverFlip/releases/latest).
2. Unpack it into `Interface/AddOns/` of your WoW Forever client, so that the file
   `Interface/AddOns/ForeverFlip/ForeverFlip.toc` exists.
3. Restart the game or type `/reload`, and make sure ForeverFlip is enabled in the AddOns list.
4. Optional:
   - bind keys under **Key Bindings → AddOns → ForeverFlip**;
   - open each profession window once, so the Crafting page knows your recipes.

> [!NOTE]
> **Current stable release: [3.3.0](https://github.com/Danissemo/ForeverFlip/releases/tag/v3.3.0)** (18 November 2026).
> **Analytics → By strategy** shows what Resale, Market reset, Bids and To vendor really earned;
> **Disenchant bought** disenchants your purchases one click each; Est./day no longer reads 0 for
> items that sell, and leans on similar items while their own sales are few. ForeverFlip Sync starts
> with Windows in the tray and shares Retail scans per region. Check all, Market reset, posting on
> Retail and two dozen other things are fixed.
> See the [3.2.0 changelog](https://github.com/ErorNya/ForeverFlip/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#320---2026-11-18).

> [!TIP]
> To update, replace the `ForeverFlip` folder, or let the
> [ForeverFlip Sync helper](https://github.com/ErorNya/ForeverFlip/blob/main/docs/community.md#addon-updates-and-beta-testing) do it: it installs new
> releases by itself, and new betas too if you tick **Beta versions**. Your data lives in
> `WTF/Account/<ACCOUNT>/SavedVariables/ForeverFlip.lua` and is kept.

| Requirement | |
|---|---|
| Game | WoW Forever 1.60.1 (Interface `16001`); Retail 12.0.5 (Interface `120105`) is capability-adapted, with in-game verification still recommended |
| Dependencies | None for the addon. The optional ForeverFlip Sync desktop helper is Windows-oriented and has its own release/build version |
| Optional | [LibAHTab](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/libahtab) puts the tab next to other addon tabs. [auxForever](https://github.com/TylerHampton/aux-forever) prices fill in materials ForeverFlip has not seen yet |
| Works next to | Auctionator, TradeSkillMaster and other auction addons |

## 🚀 Quick start

1. Open the auction house and click the **ForeverFlip** tab.
2. Click **Full scan** and let the progress bar finish. Automatic scans and the sniper can be enabled in Settings.
3. Open **Deals → To vendor** and click a deal. It is checked live; when it says **ready**,
   click **Buy**. For stackable goods, also click **Confirm purchase** once the game quotes the price.
4. Sell vendor deals, and everything else a merchant pays the most for, at any merchant with
   **Sell to vendor**. Post resale purchases with
   **Selling → My items → Post next bought**.

Resale deals need sales data, so they start to appear after two or three full scans (30–45 minutes
with the auction house open).

## ⌨️ Commands and key bindings

| Command | Action |
|---|---|
| `/ff` | Version and a short hint |
| `/ff diag` | Statistics of the last full scan |
| `/ff rescan` | Allow a full scan right away after the server did not answer |
| `/ff export` | The journal as CSV, ready to copy |
| `/ff trace` | Show the recent trace and slow-operation diagnostics |
| `/ff dev` | Toggle developer trace mode (off by default) |
| `/ff lang en` · `/ff lang uk` | Switch the language (after `/reload`) |

The Key Bindings window has five bindings (also set on **Settings → Key bindings**):

- Buy or confirm the selected deal
- Buy the next best deal (each press: check, buy, confirm)
- Post next bought (then Post all)
- Cancel the next undercut auction
- Full scan

## ❓ Questions and answers

### There are no deals after a scan

- Vendor deals depend on the market at that moment; often there are none.
- Resale needs sales data from two or three scans.
- Check the minimums in **Settings**, or try the **Aggressive** preset.
- `/ff diag` shows how many items are still collecting data.

### The Buy button stays grey

A deal can be bought only when it is **ready**, checked in the last 5 minutes, while no other search
or purchase runs. Click the deal to check it again.

### The scan does not start

The server allows one full scan per 15 minutes **per account**, and another addon may have used the
window. Wait for the countdown on the button, or use `/ff rescan` if the server did not answer.

### Is the profit guaranteed?

No. Other players see the same lots, and sales are an estimate. Several safeguards limit the risk:

- each resale buys at most about one day of sales;
- the resale price is capped at what real sales reached;
- items whose stock does not sell, or keeps coming back unsold, are trusted less;
- a purchase that fails because someone was faster costs nothing.

### What has not been confirmed on WoW Forever yet?

These are taken from Classic and checked in a simulated client only:

- the 15% cut of neutral auction houses, which is corrected from your sale invoices;
- the disenchanting table.

The [in-game checklist](https://github.com/ErorNya/ForeverFlip/blob/main/docs/testing.md#in-game-checklist) lists what to try.

### Can someone spoil the community prices with a fake scan?

Not easily. Anyone with a GitHub account can share scans, but:

- every scan is sealed by the addon while it reads it, so a scan edited afterwards is refused;
- a scan reaches the community prices only when another player's scan confirms it, and only with the
  items whose prices agree;
- deals always come from your own scans and live checks.

See [Safeguards](https://github.com/ErorNya/ForeverFlip/blob/main/docs/community.md#safeguards).

### How do I report a bug?

1. Type `/reload`.
2. Copy the `errors` section of `WTF/Account/<ACCOUNT>/SavedVariables/ForeverFlip.lua`, plus the
   output of `/ff diag`.
3. Paste both into a [bug report](https://github.com/Danissemo/ForeverFlip/issues/new/choose).

Questions go to [Discussions](https://github.com/Danissemo/ForeverFlip/discussions). A security
problem is reported privately: see the [security policy](https://github.com/ErorNya/ForeverFlip/blob/main/SECURITY.md).

## 🛠️ Local development

You need Python 3.12 and [StyLua](https://github.com/JohnnyMorganz/StyLua). The tests run the real
addon code in Lua 5.1 through [lupa](https://github.com/scoder/lupa), against a simulated WoW client
and auction house.

```bash
python -m pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
python tools/devflow.py test          # one process per module; `test <word>` narrows it
stylua --check ForeverFlip
python -m pyflakes sync tools tests
python tools/build.py
python tools/savedata.py backup       # copy the saved data out of the game (`list`, `restore <name>`)
```

`tools/build.py` checks the TOC and the version, runs the tests, writes `dist/ForeverFlip-<version>.zip`
and prints its SHA-256.

## 🤝 Contributing

Bug reports, observations of how the WoW Forever server behaves, ideas and pull requests are welcome.

- [Contributing guide](https://github.com/ErorNya/ForeverFlip/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): the code style, tests, the local flow and releases.
- [Code of conduct](https://github.com/ErorNya/ForeverFlip/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md): how we talk to each other.
- [Security policy](https://github.com/ErorNya/ForeverFlip/blob/main/SECURITY.md): how to report a security problem privately.
- [Discussions](https://github.com/Danissemo/ForeverFlip/discussions): questions, ideas and beta
  feedback that is not a bug.

releases.name: ForeverFlip 3.3.0
releases.notes:
### Added

- **Settings → Sharing says how many players share scans of your auction house.** The community
  price is only as good as the scans behind it; the count shows that it is real people, and while
  your full scans are off a line under it says how to add yours.

### Fixed

- **The totals under Deals no longer run under Sell at.** A long line ("Deals: 5 · all: cost ...,
  profit ..., expected ...") went on under the price box and its label. It now ends before them
  with "...", and the whole line shows on hover.

### Development

- **Releases upload to CurseForge, Wago and WoWInterface.** The release workflow stages the
  packaged addon for the BigWigs packager and uploads to each site whose token and project ID are
  set; CI packages it the same way without uploading, so a broken package shows before a tag.
- **A promotion kit.** `tools/promo.py post` drafts the Reddit, Discord and Telegram posts of a
  release from the changelog; `tools/promo.py metrics` reads the public numbers (downloads per
  release, players sharing per auction house). `docs/promotion.md` holds the site setup, the
  channels, a letter to creators and the shot list for screenshots and GIFs.

releases.name: ForeverFlip 3.2.0
releases.notes:
### Added

- **Analytics -> By strategy: what each strategy really earned.** Resale, Market reset, Bids and
  To vendor each get a row built from the purchases of the period: the profit of the units already
  gone (what they brought after the cut, less what they cost and the deposits lost), units sold of
  those bought, the return on their cost and per day held, and under the table the money still in
  unsold units. Profit and Sure on Deals are forecasts; this says which strategy pays on your
  server.
- **Disenchant bought, under the profession book.** Items bought on the Disenchant page had to be
  found in the bags and disenchanted one by one. A button under the profession book now
  disenchants them, one a click (the game wants a click for each cast), and shows how many are
  left. It takes only items bought to disenchant, as many as were bought, and does nothing in
  combat or while a cast or a loot window is still open.
- **ForeverFlip Sync can start with Windows, hidden in the tray.** Prices only came in while the
  helper was started by hand. **Start with Windows in the tray** (under Prices) adds it to your
  own startup list, no admin rights needed: at sign-in only the tray icon shows, and it syncs
  and shares as usual. The switch reads what Windows will really run, so removing the entry in
  Task Manager's Startup tab turns it off too. It turns on **Keep running in the tray** with it,
  and turning the tray off turns it off, so no window is left open at sign-in.

### Fixed

- **Check all no longer waits 13 s on a sold-out version.** The addon remembers each item's
  versions (item level and ending) for six hours, and searched an item with two or three of them
  one by one. When one had sold out since, the WoW Forever server sent no answer at all, and the
  check waited 12 s, asked again and only then went on: the last ten vendor deals of one Check all
  took 137 s. Every item with two remembered versions or more, not only gear with four, now asks
  for all their lowest prices in one query first and reads only the versions still listed.
- **The crafting plan stops at 100 crafts on the auction route too.** A product that sells fast
  could plan more crafts than the 100 the rule allows; the plan also spends the same money a deal
  may use (`Deals.budget`) instead of its own copy of that sum.
- **Stale deals leave the list before Check all.** Opening the auction house with deals from a scan
  of an hour ago listed them all until Check all, which then emptied the page at once: most items
  were sold or cheaper by then. When the list is two minutes old or more and nothing else is
  searching, one query now asks for the lowest price of every item, and the deals nobody sells any
  more, or whose lowest price leaves no profit, are removed. A deal checked since stays, an answer
  that is not whole removes nothing, and your own searches never wait for it.
- **No sales a day or Sure for an item the auction house never takes.** A soulbound dungeon drop
  showed Est./day and Sure from gear of about its price, though nobody can buy it there. Items that
  bind when picked up, quest items, heirlooms and warband items, and any copy the tooltip calls
  Soulbound or Warbound, now show no Demand section.
- **Cosmetic gear is no longer priced for disenchanting.** A cosmetic appearance such as Lost Soul
  Collector looks like an epic weapon but cannot be disenchanted: the Disenchant page priced it as
  if it could, and the Disenchant bought button stopped on it with "That item is not a valid
  target". Items the game marks as cosmetic, and any of item level 1, are left out.
- **Profit sorts by profit on Deals.** The column was sorted by the profit times Sure, so 271g
  stood above 580g and the arrow looked broken. It now sorts by the profit it shows; Sure has its
  own column for the chance of a sale. The other Profit columns already sorted by what they show.
- **Posting commodities on Retail goes through.** Retail takes commodity prices in whole silver
  only, and its server drops a copper price without an answer, so an undercut like 2g 3s 99c
  ended in "The auction house did not confirm the post". `C_AuctionHouse.SupportsCopperValues()`
  cannot be trusted for this (Retail did not answer false and a 2s 99c post was still dropped), so
  a Retail client is told by its version. The addon undercuts by a whole silver on Retail and
  rounds every commodity post down to it; WoW Forever keeps the copper.
- **Auction durations on Retail are 12, 24 and 48 hours.** The Duration buttons said 2, 8 and 24
  (WoW Forever's), and Auto weighed the deposits a post would lose over those hours. On Retail the
  buttons now show its hours and Auto chooses between them.
- **Est./day is one number everywhere.** The Deals column showed a figure (10.2) while the
  line under the table and the item tooltip said only "No reliable data" for the same item and
  price. Every page now shows the same estimate in the same format; while it rests on too few
  scans it is marked "~" before the number and the reason is given, instead of being hidden on some pages.
- **Market reset no longer offers items nobody buys.** An item whose price was known for less
  than three days was let through one unit on trust even when its sales were measured well and
  were zero: 5g lots showed 934g profit to relist at an asking price of 990g that never sold
  (Est./day 0, Sure 4%). A unit on trust is now taken only while sales are not measured yet, and a
  reset with reliable data and a Sure under 10% is not offered.
- **Deals are ranked by what they are worth on average.** A deal's Profit counted every unit as
  sold. The Profit column now sorts by the profit times Sure, less the deposits lost when it does
  not sell, the deal detail shows that expected profit with the return a day on the money until
  the units sell, and the line under the table adds the expected sum. A market reset worth less
  than nothing on average is no longer offered.
- **Market reset relists no higher than buyers paid.** Its price is the 7-day median of asking
  prices, which can sit above every sale: it now stays under the price 90% of the units seen sold
  reached. An item undercut more often than once in the hours its units take to sell (two
  undercuts seen at least) is not reset either: a rival under the price holds the units back, and
  the empty page counts such items.
- **Est./day of rarely seen gear leans on similar gear.** With one scan pair an item's own sales
  read near 0 a day even for gear of a kind that sells daily. While the sample is thin the
  estimate now counts the item's other endings, or gear of about its price, for the hours the
  estimate adds to its own; the more hours the item is watched, the less they count. The Deals
  column, the deal detail, Check Sure, the Sell page and the tooltip show that one figure.
- **Fated Fortune Cards (Retail).** The unread card showed a 23g merchant price, but no merchant buys
  it: it is no longer offered to one and goes to the auction house, and its tooltip says merchants
  do not buy it, as for any item a merchant was seen refusing. Read cards are soulbound, and
  Sell all left every bound item alone, so they had to be sold one by one. They are worth something
  only to a merchant, so Sell all now takes them.
- **Gear I can't use follows Retail's rules.** On Retail it used the Classic proficiencies (no
  polearms for druids, and Monks, Death Knights, Demon Hunters and Evokers were never checked). Now a
  piece counts only when no specialization of your class could wear it: a respec makes the other main
  stat wearable, so intellect leather stays for a druid while strength leather goes. Gear bound to
  the account (warband pieces, heirlooms) is never listed — an alt can wear it.
- **Disenchant works on Retail (Midnight).** Its table was Classic's, by item level up to 65:
  Midnight gear (item level 197 and up) matched no band, so the Disenchant page stayed empty after
  every

releases.name: ForeverFlip 3.1.0
releases.notes:
### Added

- **The addon says when a newer ForeverFlip is out.** The game gives addons no internet, so the
  ForeverFlip Sync helper writes the newest release of your channel (stable, or beta if you are a
  beta tester) into the community data. At login the chat names the new version, and the status
  line and the sharing page of Settings show it until you update. Needs Sync running; nothing is
  said when your version is the newest.
- **Every auction house has its own prices and header.** Alliance, Horde, the neutral goblin houses
  (15% cut) and the hardcore realms' houses are kept apart; connected realms share one house, so a
  scan shared from a connected realm joins yours. The tooltip opens with
  `=========== FOREVER FLIP: ALLIANCE AH ===========` (Horde, Neutral, Server) and closes with a
  `=== X ===` rule, so it is clear where ForeverFlip's part ends.
- **Retail support**: on Retail one house serves both factions, shown as SERVER AH; the TOC lists
  the Retail interface (120105) next to WoW Forever's 16001. Item tooltips the game keeps secret
  (Retail 12, in combat) are left alone instead of raising an error.
- **A trace of what the addon does**, to find what makes it hang: every search, check and slow
  moment with its time and reason, kept in the saved data (`ForeverFlipData.trace`, `traceStats`,
  `traceSlow`). `/ff trace` shows it, Settings → Messages → Developer turns it on or off, shows and
  clears it.
- **DEV mode** (Settings → Messages → Developer, or `/ff dev`): every click, check box, page and
  game event goes into the trace with how long it took. Off by default; a slow action is traced
  either way.

### Fixed

- **Check prices on My auctions no longer hangs on gear with many versions.** A ring known in 35
  item-key versions was searched one version after another, 25 seconds on "checking...", though
  only one of them had lots. Every gear check with four or more remembered versions now asks their
  prices in one query first and reads only the versions that are listed; with none of them listed
  the item is answered as nobody else selling it.
- **The merchant tab's offers stay on their own lines.** "Vendor … · AH …" with large prices ran
  onto a second line, over the profit line and the next offer. A line that does not fit beside the
  Buy button now leaves out its labels ("36 40 -> 46 00", "+2 95 · ~1.1/day").
- **Check all no longer stands still** ("Checking Bags: 14/15" for good): after 45 seconds without
  progress, and with nothing you do holding it (a scan, a purchase, a post), the item it waits for
  is given up as "no answer" and the rest go on. The trace says what held it.
- **Bulk buttons go down the list as you sorted it**: Check all, Post all, Post AH-worthy, Post
  next, Check prices, Cancel next undercut and the undercut answers take the top row first, on
  every page, in the order shown now.
- **Auto duration picks shorter posts where they save deposits.** It now counts how often the item
  is undercut (an undercut lot stops selling, so a long post mostly waits behind a cheaper one) and
  the item's own posts that sold against those that expired. Posts remember the duration they went
  for, and the duration tooltip on the Sell page says where the estimate came from.
- **The tooltip's header and footer sit centred across the tooltip again.** An item's long "Use:"
  text no longer stretches them across the screen, and both rules now reach the right edge: a
  two-column line was counted 20 px narrower than the game draws it (the game puts 40 px between
  the columns), and the "=" count was rounded down. The whole rule is now measured and "=" added on
  both sides until it reaches the widest line.
- **No more "no answer" on My auctions** when nobody else sells the item: the auction house's
  silence about it means your auction is alone, and it says so.
- **The tooltip rules reach the end of the price lines.** A coin icon sits 2 px to the right of
  where a measure puts it, and a price line has up to three: the rules came out a sign short. The
  icons' shift is counted, and a rule now stops within half a sign of the widest line.
- **Item names no longer blink to "item:12047"** while a quick scan checks its finds: when the
  game drops an item from its cache for a moment, the row keeps the name it showed.
- **Check all goes strictly top to bottom.** An item whose search got no answer is sent again at
  once, before the next row; it used to wait for the end of the batch, so a row above the one being
  checked kept its scan status and looked skipped.
- **Gear with many versions no longer hangs Check all.** One version of an item the server did not
  answer ended the whole search, and the check started over from the first of its 23 versions:
  Nomad Trousers stood on "checking..." for half a minute. Now that one version is asked once more
  and the versions already read are kept.
- **The tooltip's header and footer are the same width.** Each had the same number of "=" on both
  sides, so its width moved two signs at a time, and the "X" line could stand a sign out past the
  header. Now one side may hold a sign more, and a few spaces around the middle take up the rest.
  The widths are measured in the font the tooltip's own lines are drawn in, not in a font object of
  the same name that kept "=", spaces and letters in other proportions. In DEV mode the trace keeps
  the expected and the drawn width of both lines (`tooltip.rules`). That trace showed the game
  drawing the "X" line 5 to 6 px wider than measured while the header came out as measured, so the
  addon now learns that difference from the tooltips it has drawn (per font, kept in the saved
  data as `tipSkew`) and aims the "X" line short by it.
- **The summary under the menu is no longer cut short.** Its lines were counted once, when a page
  was opened; if the window was still being laid out, only four lines fit and the sniper's figures
  were gone until another page was opened. They are counted again at every refresh now.
- **Quick scan works with the sniper on.** While the full scan waited its 15 minutes, the button
  only counted down whenever the sniper ran, so Quick scan could not be pressed. Now it reads one
  whole round of its own and lists what it finds, and the sniper goes on afterwards. Switching the
  sniper off no longer cuts a quick scan short.
- **Check all reads gear much faster.** Each version of an item waited for the auction house's
  throttle, so a piece of gear with 30 versions took about 20 seconds. Check all now asks the
  lowest price of all versions in one query and reads only those that could change the deal; if
  that answer does not come, every version is read as before.
- **Analytics: the list buttons stay inside the window.** The seven buttons above the list (Bargains
  … My results) share the row's width instead of a fixed 96 px each, which pushed My results past
  the edge.
- **Analytics: Today's chart goes hour by hour** instead of one block filling the chart; 7 and 30
  days stay a bar a day.
- **After a buy out on Undercuts the row says "bought"** instead of a grey "wait", and the price is
  checked again, so the next answer comes from the new market.

### Changed

- **The addon's files are sorted into folders**: `Core`, `Locale`, `Modules`, `UI`, as other addons
  do. Nothing about the speed changes; the game loads the same files in the same order. Because
  files moved, the game needs a full restart after the update, not a `/reload`. The zip now
  carries `README.md` and `CHANGELOG.md` next to the licence.

### Development

- DEV mode also traces every status message, and the posting buttons trace each item they post,
  hold or wait for (post.go, post.held, post.wait), next to every click and its time: "the button
  did nothing" can be read from the trace.
